u0: Initial blocker stage: the ball still blocks the only reachable cell for toggling the locked door, so the door cannot be opened. The active objective is to clear the blocker by picking up the ball (blocker_moved). Prefer moving the ball before taking the key; if you already carry the matching key, put it down safely first, because dropping it while the door remains closed triggers key_lost.
u1: Blocker-cleared stage: the ball has been moved off the door-adjacent cell at least once, but the matching door key has not yet been acquired. The next objective is to free your hands if needed (drop the ball away from the door cell) and pick up the key matching the door's color. Keep the door-adjacent cell clear so the door can later be toggled.
u2: Matching-key stage: the door key has been acquired, but the door is still closed. The next objective is to carry the key to the locked door and toggle it open (door_open). Hold onto the key until the door opens; do not drop it while the door remains closed, since that fires key_lost. If the key is no longer carried, recover the matching key before attempting to unlock.
u3: Door-open stage: the door has been unlocked and opened at least once, but the mission-designated box has not yet been picked up. The next objective is to reach the box in the other room and pick it up (target_picked_up); reopen the door if it is currently shut. If still carrying the key, free your hands by dropping it only while the door is open, then collect the target box.
u4: Terminal success state: the mission-designated target box has been picked up, so the episode ends immediately. No further progress is possible or needed.
